SwitchPreference.android:title: Start at Boot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Automatically run DFRoot on device boot

ListPreference.android:title: Boot Mode
ListPreference.android:summary: Pilih mode eksekusi saat boot (KernelSU atau Shell)

SwitchPreference.android:title: Auto Soft Reboot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Applies to both Manual Start and Start at Boot.\nNOTE: this will only work if your SU manager supports it as a late-load arg

SwitchPreference.android:title: Disable KSU Modules
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Turn this on if a broken module is crashing your device. The next run will launch with all modules disabled.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Auto Start Shizuku
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Otomatis jalankan service Shizuku saat root berhasil aktif
